description: A repository with no commits at all, so HEAD is unborn and no branch name can be read. The lane selects every rule below it, so this exits 1 rather than guessing — guessing is how a feature branch gets graded as the trunk. Note what the FIRST attempt at this fixture produced: a recipe carrying one commit and no checkout answered "not applicable ('main' is the trunk)" and exited 0 — a different rule passing quietly in this one's place, which is what a hand-written expectation catches and a generated one would have enshrined.
